title: EgressJobListResponse
description: Paginated list of export jobs for the Activity Center

jobs.description: Export job summaries for the current page

pageSize.description: Page size used for this response

pageOffset.description: Page offset used for this response

totalCount.description: Total number of jobs matching the filters

EgressJobSummaryDto.description: Summary view of an export job for the Activity Center

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for the export job

templateId.description: Template ID used for the export, if any

templateName.description: Template name used for the export, if any. Currently always null pending DAL support for including the template name in this endpoint's response (CP-35412 follow-up).

status.description: Current status of the export job

expectedRows.description: Expected number of rows for the export

unsuccessfulRows.description: Number of rows that failed to export

initiatedByUserId.description: User ID that initiated the export job

createdAt.description: Timestamp the export job was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp the export job was last updated

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp the export job was cancelled, if applicable

cancelledByUserId.description: User ID that requested cancellation, if applicable

exportType.description: Export kind of the template behind this job (CP-41063): FULL_ROSTER_EXPORT (default when the egress service omits it) or CHANGE_FILE

changeFileWindowFrom.description: Change File runs only: start of the change window (exclusive), ISO-8601

changeFileWindowTo.description: Change File runs only: end of the change window (inclusive), ISO-8601

transactionsSelected.description: Change File runs only: transactions selected from the change ledger for the window

rowsWritten.description: Change File runs only: rows written to the delivered file

startedAt.description: Timestamp the export job started. Derived alias for createdAt (the DAL does not track a distinct start time separate from job creation).

finishedAt.description: Timestamp the export job finished (reached a terminal status). Derived alias for updatedAt once status is COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED; null while still running, since the DAL overwrites updatedAt on every intermediate status change.
